newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RFM sets date for preferred share offer.
newsitem.headline: RFM sets date for preferred share offer.

text.p: Diversified food company RFM Corp said on Friday it had set February 6 as the record date of its convertible preferred share offer.
The company also announced the Philippine Stock Exchange had approved the listing of the convertible preferred share issue.
The offering, which will raise about 1.0 to 1.2 billion pesos, will start February 24 and end March 14. It will finance investments of its real estate and beverage units.
The offer price of the shares is expected to range from 4.50 to 5.00 pesos and will be fully payable upon susbcription, RFM said.
The number of shares each shareholder can buy will be determined once the offer price has been set, RFM said. However, the conversion ratio for every convertible preferred share is one common share.
Conversion can be exercised 180 days from the issue date.
The preferred shares will carry a fixed dividend rate of 10 percent yearly, the company said.
The lead underwriter of this offering is BPI Capital Corp.
